name: orca-universal-proxy
description: Universal proxy for Codex CLI, Claude Desktop, and all major Chinese LLM APIs

scripts.build:ui: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=cjs --minify
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['data/billing.json', 'data/config.json', 'data/logs'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.package: npm run prepackage && npm run build:ui && tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=cjs --minify && electron-builder --win
